assumptions: All 111 chips are from the unchanged frozen test role.
RTC scene selection uses metadata and exact C2S acquisition identity before raster reads.
Both RTC dates use compatible linear gamma0, platform, relative orbit, direction and exact target grid.
Labels include permanent water; the change baseline targets new inundation.
Existing models and calibrators trained on GRD remain frozen; applying them to RTC is a domain transfer.
Same post-RTC inputs and joint valid masks permit a pipeline comparison, not newly flooded-land accuracy.
Missing matched pairs are exclusions; no alternate event date or product is substituted.
attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data; RTC by Catalyst, hosted by Microsoft. C2S-MS labels: Cloud to Street, Microsoft, Radiant Earth (2022), DOI10.34911/rdnt.oz32gz.
